# Load libraries

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(purrr)
library(beanplot)
```

# Load the gene ID conversion table

```{r}
conversion <- read.csv(
  here("data", "biomart_ensembl_gene_symbol.txt"),
  header = TRUE
)
```

# Load the gene expression data

```{r}
logRSEM_files <- list.files(
  here("data"),
  pattern = "log2RSEM.csv",
  full.names = TRUE
)

logRSEM_data <- map(
  logRSEM_files,
  function(file) {
    df <- fread(file, header = TRUE) |> as.data.frame()
    row.names(df) <- df[, 1]
    df[, -1]
  }
)

# Extract cancer types from file names
cancer_types <- gsub(".*/(.*?)_log2RSEM\\.csv$", "\\1", logRSEM_files)

head(logRSEM_data[[1]][, 1:5])
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
# Prepare RBP expression data in long format
prepare_rbp_expression <- function(logRSEM_data, cancer_types, rbp) {
  # Extract expression for RBP across all datasets
  expr_list <- imap(logRSEM_data, function(df, idx) {
    tibble(
      sample = colnames(df),
      expression = as.numeric(df[rbp, ]),
      cancer_type = cancer_types[idx]
    )
  })
  
  # Combine into long format
  bind_rows(expr_list) |>
    # Extract sample type from sample code (01 = tumor, other = normal)
    mutate(
      sample_type = if_else(grepl("-01$", sample), "Tumor", "Normal"),
      .keep = "unused"
    ) |>
    # Remove zero expression values (pseudocount floor)
    filter(expression != log2(0.0001)) |>
    # Remove cancers with no normal samples
    group_by(cancer_type) |>
    filter(n_distinct(sample_type) > 1) |>
    ungroup()
}

# Order cancer types by median tumor expression
order_by_expression <- function(data) {
  # Calculate median expression in tumors
  tumor_medians <- data |>
    filter(sample_type == "Tumor") |>
    group_by(cancer_type) |>
    summarise(median_expr = median(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(median_expr)) |>
    pull(cancer_type)
  
  data |>
    mutate(cancer_type = factor(cancer_type, levels = tumor_medians))
}

# Plot RBP expression across cancer types as split bean violins
plot_rbp_expression <- function(data, rbp) {
  # Color mapping for sample types
  colors <- c(Normal = "cornflowerblue", Tumor = "darkgoldenrod2")

  data <- mutate(data, sample_type = factor(sample_type, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")))

  par(las = 2)
  beanplot(
    expression ~ sample_type * cancer_type,
    data = data,
    side = "both",
    col = list(colors[["Normal"]], c(colors[["Tumor"]], "black")),
    ll = 0,
    maxwidth = 1.3,
    beanlinewd = 2,
    maxstripline = 0,
    horizontal = FALSE,
    show.names = FALSE,
    xlab = "",
    ylab = paste0(rbp, " expression log2(RSEM)")
  )
  axis(
    side = 1,
    at = seq_along(levels(data$cancer_type)),
    labels = levels(data$cancer_type),
    cex.axis = 1
  )
  legend("topright", fill = colors, legend = names(colors), bty = "n")
}

# Save plot
save_pdf <- function(plot_fun, filename, output_dir, width = 8, height = 6) {
  output_path <- file.path(output_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf"))
  pdf(output_path, width = width, height = height)
  plot_fun()
  dev.off()
  message("Saved: ", output_path)
}
```

# Expression plots for DDX55, PTBP1, RPLP0, and FAM120A

```{r}
rbps_to_plot <- c("DDX55", "PTBP1", "RPLP0", "FAM120A")

rbp_data <- map(
  rbps_to_plot,
  function(rbp) {
    prepare_rbp_expression(logRSEM_data, cancer_types, rbp) |>
      order_by_expression()
  }
) |>
  set_names(rbps_to_plot)

# Save all plots
iwalk(rbp_data, function(data, rbp) {
  save_pdf(function() plot_rbp_expression(data, rbp),
           paste0(rbp, "_expression"),
           here("TCGA", "output", "figures"),
           width = 8, height = 3.5)
})
```

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 7}
# Display all plots
iwalk(rbp_data, function(data, rbp) plot_rbp_expression(data, rbp))
```
